stations.note: The ten thirty has no seats.

stations.title: rides.js
stations.text: The ten thirty has no seats left.

captions: At the tram stop, Wilf wants the rides screen to say plainly which rides are full.
Every row shows every mark, so the ten thirty reads 0 seats left and step-free.
You make each part of the rides screen depend on the ride, in five tasks.
The ten thirty says it is full, and each row shows only what is true of it.
Same rota, a screen that decides. Wilf's notice appears only on days he writes one.
